headlines.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
headlines.summary: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

headlines.title: Berkshire Hathaway doubles down on the U.S. housing market with a fresh bet on this stock
headlines.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has upped its bet on the U.S. housing market, and also boosted its stakes in Alphabet and Delta Air Lines.

headlines.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
headlines.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Company’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

headlines.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
headlines.summary: Berkshire owned about 106 million shares in the parent of Google, worth $37.9 billion at the end of June, according to a regulatory filing released Friday.

headlines.title: U.S. to use economic tactics on Iran 'that have never been seen'; Navy works to relieve troubled carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
headlines.summary: The Trump administration is ratcheting up rhetorical pressure on Iran as the military conflict in Iran appears mired in a strategic stalemate.

headlines.title: Self-driving trucks are officially testing on California highways
headlines.summary: Aurora Innovation and Kodiak AI, two companies developing self-driving trucks, have received permits from the California Department of Motor Vehicles.

headlines.title: Goldman’s latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
headlines.summary: Nvidia and Intel recently tapped the bank to help them meeting soaring demand for compute.

headlines.title: Drone stocks rally after Trump orders tariffs on foreign-made components
headlines.summary: The U.S. is looking to scale defense manufacturing and chip away at China's drone dominance.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case related to UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
headlines.summary: Mangione's lawyers argue his federal plea bars his prosecution for murder in state court for Brian Thompson's slaying due to New York's double jeopardy law

headlines.title: Thrive’s Joshua Kushner chides Silicon Valley VCs over AI euphoria
headlines.summary: The AI opportunity is huge, but "it would also be a grave error in our minds to let excitement weaken our investment discipline," Kushner warns in his first-ever investment letter.

headlines.title: Regulators and banks step up scrutiny of prediction markets
headlines.summary: The CFTC is reviewing prediction betting platforms' so-called mention markets, people familiar with the matter confirmed to CNBC.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump tore down the White House East Wing to make way for the ballroom project.
